newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks to fall, Korean Air crash to hurt.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks to fall, Korean Air crash to hurt.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to fall on Wednesday after two consecutive days of rises with shares of Korean Air Lines and the insurance sector pulling the market down, brokers said.
The composite stock index closed Tuesday up 6.67 points to 740.86.
"Shares of Korean Air and insurance companies are expected to tumble from the start on the crash news," said Koh Soon-shik of LG Securities.
A Korean Air jumbo jet carrying 231 passengers crashed on the Pacific island of Guam early on Wednesday.
